{"id":10201188008184,"title":"Hydra Glow Sun Protection Gel-60ml","handle":"hydra-glow-sun-protection-gel-60ml","description":"Protect your skin with this transparent sunscreen for the face, uniquely formulated to give you maximum protection, deep hydration, and a flawless finish without an embarrassing white cast. It is also enriched with hyaluronic acid, essential antioxidants, and an impressive SPF 50+ PA+++ rating. This gel shields your skin from 98% of harmful UVA and UVB rays. Step out in confidence, fully protected and with your glow on! Keep your skin fully protected with our full range of sunscreens.

Ingredients In This Transparent Sunscreen For Face

Homosolate, Tinosorb S, Amiloxate, Bis-Ethylhexyloxphenol, Isoamyl P-Methoxycinnamate, Methoxphenyl Triazine, Octisalate, Avobenzone, Aqua, Glycerin, Caprylyl Methicone, Ethylhexyl Triazone, Butyloctyl Salicylate, Tocopheryl Acetate, Pentylene Glycol, Hyaluronic Acid Acrylates/Dimethicone Copolymer, Hydroxymethoxphenyl Decanone, Phenoxyethanol, Silica, Disodium EDTA, Chlorphenesin, and Glyceryl Stearate. N/B: Every ingredient list is specific to an individual product reference. All formulas are subject to change. While we endeavour to keep this ingredient list accurate, please also refer to the product’s outer packaging ingredient list for a complete, accurate, and up-to-date list.

Why Choose The HydraGlow Sun Protection Gel

  • Broad-Spectrum Protection: With an impressive SPF 50+ PA+++ rating, this gel shields your skin from 98% of harmful UVA and UVB rays, ensuring over 500 hours of sun protection.
  • Hyaluronic Acid: This sunscreen is enriched with hyaluronic acid. This locks in moisture, leaving your skin feeling soft, supple, and deeply hydrated.
  • Antioxidant Power: Infused with powerful antioxidants, it helps combat free radicals, reducing the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, and promoting healthier, more youthful-looking skin.
  • Suitable for all Skin Types: This water-based, clear sunscreen for face is suitable for all skin types.
How To Use 
  • Cleanse your face with a face wash of your choice.
  • To enhance the effectiveness of your product, go in with your preferred face toner.
  • You should also consider including a face serum that targets specific skin issues, followed by your desired face moisturizer. A well-known ingredient that pairs well with hyaluronic acid is niacinamide.
  • Now, this sunscreen should be the last step in your morning routine. Squeeze this sun gel onto your index, middle and ring fingers and apply it to all exposed areas (face, neck, and arms).
  • Apply 15-30 minutes before going outside.
Reapply as Needed: Reapply every 2 hours or immediately after swimming or sweating. Combine with Your Routine: Use this clear sunscreen for your face as part of your daily skincare routine for enhanced hydration and protection. Size 60ml Shelf Life 1 year from the date of first use.

FAQs: Transparent Sunscreen

What is this transparent sunscreen, and how does it differ from regular sunscreen?

Clear sunscreen is formulated to be transparent upon application, avoiding the white cast that traditional mineral sunscreens can leave on the skin. It typically uses chemical filters that absorb UV rays rather than physical blockers like zinc oxide or titanium dioxide.

Is this transparent sunscreen effective against both UVA and UVB rays?

Yes, most clear sunscreens are designed to provide broad-spectrum protection, which means they defend against both UVA rays (which contribute to skin ageing) and UVB rays (which cause sunburn)

Can I wear makeup over this transparent sunscreen?

Yes, many clear sunscreens are designed to be lightweight and non-greasy, making them suitable as a base under makeup. Some products even enhance makeup application by providing a smooth finish.

Does this clear sunscreen clog pores or cause breakouts?

Many clear sunscreens are formulated to be non-comedogenic, meaning they are less likely to clog pores.
